'''Mondé''', or '''Salamãi''', is a nearly extinct [[Tupian languages|Tupian language]] of the state of [[Rondônia]], in the Amazon region of [[Brazil]].

Other names include ''Sanamaikã, Sanamaicá, Salamãi''.<ref name="Campbell-SAmerica">{{cite book |last=Campbell |first=Lyle |author-link=Lyle Campbell |editor1-last=Grondona |editor1-first=Verónica |editor2-last=Campbell |editor2-first=Lyle |date=2012 |title=The Indigenous Languages of South America |chapter=Classification of the indigenous languages of South America |series=The World of Linguistics |volume=2 |location=Berlin |publisher=De Gruyter Mouton |pages=59–166 |isbn=978-3-11-025513-3}}</ref>
